mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.50% and is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS > 0.50% and rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strong labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) and strong housing market activity (HOUST) signal persistent demand pressures that boost corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when the regime is identified as late-cycle expansion (based on CPIAUCSL and HOUST), or the Rank IC for the regime condition over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when INDPRO has increased for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1700 thousand units and consumer spending (RSAFS) declines, it signals a weakening demand environment that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the months when HOUST < 1700 and RSAFS declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when UNRATE > 6.0% and UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in consumer price inflation signals a 'soft landing' monetary policy that supports growth without excessive inflation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the months when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
